'''Dark troopers'''<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref> were a type of [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] employed by [[Darth Jadus]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. They were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] which wore reflective [[Color/Legends|black]] body [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and face-concealing helmets similar to what Jadus's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] followers wore during the same period, and were typically equipped with [[DLA-13 heavy blaster rifle]]s.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" /><ref name="Legacy Reborn" />  Around [[3622 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> they were used to guard [[Darth Nul]]'s former starship, the ''[[Enigma (research vessel)|Enigma]]'', while Jadus was conducting research there. These troopers were used to apprehend the [[Alliance Commander]] when they refused Jadus's offer to work together, and the Commander dispatched several of them during their subsequent [[Mission to the Enigma|escape]].<ref name="The Master's Enigma" /> Dark troopers were also deployed in large numbers to protect [[Naga Sadow's fortress]] during the [[Battle of Khar Shian]], many of which were dispatched by [[Darth Malgus]] and the forces of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
